parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair. The name must conform to the following naming conventions:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。命名规则如下所示：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。

必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

KeyPairFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The message-digest algorithm 5 (MD5) is used based on the public key fingerprint format defined in RFC 4716. For more information, see RFC 4716 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)
KeyPairFingerPrint.description_zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法。详情请参见RFC4716 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)

KeyPairId.description_en: The ID of the SSH key pair

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair

PrivateKeyBody.description_en: The private key of the key pair. The private key is encoded with PEM in the PKCS#8 format
PrivateKeyBody.description_zh: 密钥对的私钥。PEM编码的PKCS#8格式的私钥部分
